title: Research bounded E6 one-extra frame decoder screen
body:
## Result

Adds a reproducible, exact screen for one seven-term E6 decoder mechanism: a one-extra rank-one extension of the six-term Gram factorization, with the dense pairing `B0` fixed. Across the 36 projective E6 root directions, all 364 projective `{-1,0,1}^6` directions in the pinned basis, and all rational lambda support cells, the minimum raw and fully charged Theorem C costs are both 40. This family therefore misses the requested cost-35 target. The result is scoped to this factorization and finite direction alphabet; it does not settle arbitrary seven-term E6 decoders and makes no kappa claim.

The package includes the exact identity, root/basis reconstruction, breakpoint coverage argument, cost certificate, positive fixtures, and negative controls. It preserves the initial root-only screen (566 cells, minimum 42) and records the one bounded pivot to the ternary directions.

## Pins and reproduction

- Exact base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`
- Cycle 30 seed: `4dd9ff38bfc63aa200c17c947da92d9e`; track `complex-mechanisms`
- Package: `research/e6-one-extra-frame-seed4dd9/`
- Reproduce: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/e6-one-extra-frame-seed4dd9`

Checks completed locally:
- Package metadata and source pins pass.
- Exact package verifier passes normally and under `python3 -O` on Python 3.14.7.
- The predecessor's focused E6 exact baseline check passes, confirming the six-term reference ranks `(6,7,6,6,6,6)` and cost 37.
- `git diff --check` passes.

The registered replay hook is configured for Python 3.12, which is not installed in this environment; its wrapper reports that requirement. The declared verifier itself was run directly under the available Python 3.14.7. CI replay remains useful for the configured runtime.

## Scope and credit

This differs from the rank-four E6 screens in PRs #2137 and #2232: it uses seven terms and a redundant rank-one frame, holding `G` and `B0` fixed. It builds on merged PR #1590's root-unit model and Theorem C pricing; open PR #2228 separately leaves overcomplete E6 at seven terms open. No physical supplier mapping, changed paid profile, selected-frontier change, or independent human review is claimed. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 assistance.
